question: What is the return policy for electronics purchased online?
expected_answer: Electronics purchased online can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, provided they are in original packaging and unused condition. Opened items may be subject to a 15% restocking fee.

question: How do I reset my account password?
expected_answer: To reset your password, go to the login page and click 'Forgot Password'. Enter your registered email address, and you will receive a password reset link within 5 minutes. The link expires after 24 hours.

question: What are the system requirements for ProductX Pro v3.0?
expected_answer: ProductX Pro v3.0 requires Windows 10/11 or macOS 12+, 8GB RAM minimum (16GB recommended), 4-core CPU, 2GB free disk space, and an internet connection for activation and updates.

question: Can I upgrade from the Basic plan to the Enterprise plan mid-billing cycle?
expected_answer: Yes, you can upgrade at any time. The price difference is prorated for the remaining days in your current billing cycle. The new features become available immediately after the upgrade.

question: Why is my API integration returning 429 errors?
expected_answer: A 429 error means you have exceeded the rate limit. The Basic plan allows 60 requests per minute, Standard allows 300, and Enterprise allows 1000. Check your current usage in the dashboard under Settings > API Usage.

question: Does ProductX support integration with Salesforce?
expected_answer: Yes, ProductX supports native Salesforce integration starting from the Professional plan. You can connect via the Integrations page in Settings. The integration supports bi-directional sync of contacts, deals, and custom objects.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
expected_answer: We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, PayPal, wire transfers for annual plans, and purchase orders for Enterprise customers. All payments are processed securely through our PCI-compliant payment processor.

question: How do I export my data if I want to cancel my subscription?
expected_answer: Go to Settings > Data Management > Export. You can export all your data in CSV or JSON format. The export includes all records, attachments, and configuration settings. Data exports are available for 30 days after account cancellation.

question: What is the difference between ProductX Standard and ProductX Pro?
expected_answer: ProductX Pro includes all Standard features plus: advanced analytics dashboard, custom workflow automation, priority support with 4-hour SLA, SSO/SAML authentication, and API rate limits of 1000 req/min vs 300 for Standard.

question: Is there a free trial available?
expected_answer: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial of the Professional plan with no credit card required. The trial includes full access to all Professional features. At the end of the trial, you can choose any plan or your account will be downgraded to the free tier.

question: My dashboard is showing stale data from yesterday. How do I fix this?
expected_answer: Try clearing your browser cache and refreshing the page. If the issue persists, check the data sync status under Settings > Integrations. The default sync interval is 15 minutes. You can trigger a manual sync by clicking the 'Sync Now' button.

question: What compliance certifications does your platform have?
expected_answer: Our platform is SOC 2 Type II certified, GDPR compliant, HIPAA compliant (Enterprise plan), and ISO 27001 certified. We undergo annual third-party security audits and penetration testing.

question: How do I add team members to my organization account?
expected_answer: Navigate to Settings > Team Management > Invite Members. Enter the email addresses of team members and select their role (Admin, Editor, or Viewer). They will receive an invitation email with a link to join your organization.

question: What is your uptime SLA for Enterprise customers?
expected_answer: Enterprise customers receive a 99.95% uptime SLA with financial credits for any downtime exceeding the guarantee. This translates to a maximum of approximately 22 minutes of unplanned downtime per month.

question: Can I use ProductX on mobile devices?
expected_answer: Yes, ProductX has native mobile apps for iOS (14+) and Android (11+). The mobile app supports most features including dashboards, notifications, and basic record management. Advanced features like workflow builder are only available on desktop.

question: How do I configure webhook notifications for my integration?
expected_answer: Go to Settings > Integrations > Webhooks. Click 'Add Webhook', enter your endpoint URL, select the events to subscribe to (e.g., record.created, record.updated), and optionally add a secret for HMAC signature verification.

question: What happens to my data if my account is inactive for an extended period?
expected_answer: Free tier accounts are flagged as inactive after 90 days of no login activity. You will receive email warnings at 60 and 80 days. After 90 days, data is archived but retained for 12 months. Paid accounts are never auto-archived as long as the subscription is active.

question: Does ProductX support custom fields and objects?
expected_answer: Yes, the Professional and Enterprise plans support custom fields (text, number, date, dropdown, multi-select) and custom objects. You can create up to 50 custom fields per object on Professional and unlimited on Enterprise.

question: I am getting a 'connection timeout' error when trying to sync data. What should I do?
expected_answer: Connection timeouts usually indicate network issues. Check that your firewall allows outbound connections to api.productx.com on port 443. If behind a proxy, ensure it is configured in Settings > Network. Try increasing the timeout value in integration settings to 60 seconds.

question: What are the data residency options for EU customers?
expected_answer: EU customers can choose to have their data stored in our Frankfurt (eu-central-1) data center. Data residency is configured at the organization level during onboarding and cannot be changed after initial setup. All data processing for EU-resident organizations occurs within the EU.
